artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman shown from the waist up, holding a scepter in one hand and an orb in the other. She has light-colored hair, a composed expression, and an elaborate gown with intricate patterns. She wears a large ruff collar, a crown with jewels, and jewelry. The background is a dark textured archway, and the text underneath reads "Elizabetha Regina."

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a woman, facing forward and seated. She has a complex hairstyle with curls and a decorative headpiece, and a composed facial expression. She wears an intricately patterned dress with a high collar, long sleeves, and various geometric and floral designs. The attire is highly ornate, possibly indicating royalty. She holds a scepter in her right hand and a globus cruciger in her left. The background is plain with a subtle pattern.

artworks.title: Elizabeth, Queen of England
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a woman shown from the waist up. She is positioned facing forward with her head slightly turned to her left. She has a fair complexion and her facial features include prominent, expressive eyes and a delicate, slightly elongated nose. Her hair is styled in a tight, curly fashion, augmented by an intricate headpiece with decorative elements. She wears a lavish garment decorated with intricate patterns and adorned with pearls. A prominent lace ruff surrounds her neck, and the bodice of her dress is embellished with jewels. Her attire also includes puffed sleeves. She is wearing drop earrings and a necklace with a central jewel. The background features a detailed, circular frame with an embossed design, surrounded by Latin script. Decorative elements, including a crown and a floral motif, adorn the corners of the portrait.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in a regal manner. She has a composed posture with her hands delicately positioned at her front, one holding a fan. Her facial features appear dignified with high cheekbones and a neutral expression, framed by styled hair adorned with a crown or tiara and a semicircle of stars above. Her hair is curled and enhanced by a feathered headpiece. She wears a gown with patterns, embellishments, and a large ruff around her neck. The woman is adorned with jewelry, including a necklace with a pendant. The background features heraldic imagery, including a coat of arms surrounded by illustrations of lions and other symbols, set against a representation of clouds.

artworks.title: The Tomb of Elizabeth I
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a funerary monument. The drawing features an elaborate tomb or catafalque with an effigy of a figure lying beneath a grand archway. The monument is detailed with columns, coat of arms, heraldic symbols, decorative motifs, and a lion figure on top of the archway. Inscriptions and verses are found at the base of the monument, presented in mirror-flipped text. The composition conveys regal majesty and solemnity.

artworks.title: Elizabeth's Tomb
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a tomb monument with a recumbent figure. The figure appears regal and solemn, with intricate detailing, a monochromatic color scheme, multiple columns, a grand arch, a crown, a lion, shields, and symbols. The monument is elevated on a plinth and surrounded by a fence.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth Memorial
artworks.description: An engraved image depicts a queen seated on a throne. The queen is shown holding a scepter in her right hand and a royal orb in her left. Surrounding her are three men. The throne is decorated with arches and flowers, and there is a draped cloth above the queen. The background features symbolic figures like an angel and a creature holding a pen to a book. The engraving includes decorations like a scroll and a decorative border. The inscription reads "ELISABETHA REGINA."

artworks.title: Elizabeth - Sphaera Civitatis (Globe of Citizens)
artworks.description: The image depicts the head and shoulders of a person with a stylized and detailed appearance. The individual is shown facing forward with their head slightly turned to the right. They have a complex hairstyle with curls and a crown-like headdress. The person has an oval face, small eyes, and a serene smile. They are wearing an ornate costume with a high collar and decorative shoulder coverings. The person is positioned above a diagram with concentric circles labeled with Latin words, surrounded by phrases and text at the bottom. The background is a textured surface.

artworks.title: Elizabeth, Queen of Bohemia
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, standing with one hand on a table and the other holding a fabric, possibly a handkerchief. She has a composed expression, direct gaze, delicate eyebrows, and a slightly downturned mouth. She has curly hair with a decorative headpiece featuring pearls and intricate design elements. Her ornate attire includes a dress with lace detailing around the collar and cuffs, adorned with decorative patterns and a chain or emblem across the chest. She wears an earring and a jewel-decorated chain around her neck. The background features a textured curtain.

artworks.title: Marriage of Elizabeth to Frederick V of Bohemia, February 14, 1613
artworks.description: The image shows a grand ceremonial procession. The scene features an elaborate parade with rows of elegantly dressed figures, soldiers, officials, and musicians marching through a large archway into a courtyard or open area. Multiple groups are organized in procession, with some carrying banners and others wearing elaborate garments and armor. The background includes grand buildings with balconies filled with onlookers. The overall composition is intricately detailed, showcasing the formal order and grandeur typical of a significant historical or royal event.

artworks.title: Richard Elton of Bristol
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in armor with curly hair, holding a baton. He is positioned facing slightly to the right, and his facial features include a prominent nose and lips. Surrounding him are decorative elements such as draped cloth, armor, and weaponry. Above him is a crest with stars and stripes, and below is a circular element with Roman numerals and text. The background has intricate lines and shading, with Latin inscriptions on the frame. The lower section features a block of text that may be a dedication or commemoration.

artworks.title: Emmanuel Philibert, Duke of Savoy
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing within an arched architectural frame. He has a beard and mustache and styled hair. He wears noble clothing, including a cloak, doublet, skirt, and pointed shoes. He holds an ornamental item in one hand and a sword hangs at his side. In the background, there is a landscape with water, a tree, hills, and a fortress or castle. The floor is tiled.

artworks.title: Emmanuel Philibert of Savoy
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a full-length portrait. He is standing upright with one hand holding a sword and the other hand on his waist. The man has a pointed beard, mustache, and a poised expression. He wears a feathered hat, a decorated jerkin with puffed sleeves, high collar, and decorative shorts. He also wears a cloak with stripes and pointed shoes with ankle ties. The detailed background includes mountains, a castle on a hill, trees, and a body of water, framed within an archway.

artworks.title: Emmanuel Philibert, Duke of Savoy, Prince of Piedmont
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper torso, slightly turned to the left but facing forward. He has distinct facial features including a prominent nose, sharp cheekbones, and a mustache and goatee. His hair is styled back and appears light in color. He is wearing an intricate outfit with a high, lace-trimmed ruff collar, dark clothing with elaborate embroidery and decorative patterns, including a detailed chain or sash across his chest. The background is dark, and there is an oval frame around the portrait.

artworks.title: Enno Ludovick, Count of East Friesland and His Wife, Catherina Henriette
artworks.description: The image shows two children, a boy and a girl, depicted from about the knees up. The boy is on the left, standing with his body slightly turned to the side but his face looking forward. He has shoulder-length hair with a center part. He is wearing an ornate, long-sleeved garment with a lace collar and cuffs, and buttons down the front, and a sash around his waist. Beside him is a drum, and he holds a drumstick in his hand. The girl on the right is also standing with her body slightly turned to the side but facing forward. She has curly hair styled into ringlets, framing her face, and she wears a similar ornate dress with a large lace collar and cuffs, adorned with bows and a decorative belt. She holds a branch with fruit and an object that appears to be a fan. Both children wear necklaces, and the fabric of their clothes is richly detailed. They are in front of a large carved column, covered by heavy drapery, framing a view behind them of a waterfront scene with a large castle or palace, ships in the water, and clouds in the sky. Above them, there are cherubs holding a decorative emblem or coat of arms. The drapery behind them ends in a scalloped edge above their heads.

artworks.title: Desiderius Erasmus
artworks.artist: Hendrick Bary after Hans Holbein the Elder
artworks.description: The image is an illustration showing a man from the waist up in profile, looking to the right. The man has distinct facial features, a long nose, sharp features, and visible wavy hair on the side of his face. He wears a dark hat covering most of his hair, which is slightly curled and of medium length. He wears a dark, fur-lined robe with a tassel at the front. The background has horizontal lines. At the bottom, there is text in Dutch.

artworks.title: Desiderius Erasmus Rotterdam
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with his hands resting on a stone bust labeled "TERMINVS." The man has a prominent, angular face with short, wavy hair and is dressed in a draped robe with a belt. He holds a small rectangular object in his right hand, and there are classical architectural elements surrounding him. Latin text is visible at the top and bottom of the image, providing context about the figure.

artworks.title: Eric XIV, King of Sweden
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man from the waist up. He is positioned slightly to the side, with his gaze directed to the right. The man has a long, full beard and short, slightly wavy hair. He is wearing a suit of armor with decorative patterns and bands, and a chain around his neck. One of his arms is bent at the elbow. The background is a simple oval frame with inscriptions along the edge, and the illustration is in a monochrome style.

artworks.title: Eric XIV, King of Sweden
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man in a powerful stance. He is turned slightly to the side, with his right hand resting on the hilt of a sword and his left hand on his hip. The man has a prominent, full beard and short, closely cropped hair. He is dressed in elaborate armor covering his torso and arms, with ornate details and patterns. Below the armor, he wears intricately designed puffed breeches. A large plumed helmet rests at his feet. In the background is a textured setting with a shield bearing a royal coat of arms and text indicating his regal status.

artworks.title: Ernest, Archduke of Austria
artworks.artist: Pieter de Jode II after Otto van Veen
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a man facing slightly left. He has a distinct facial appearance with a well-groomed mustache and neatly trimmed beard. His hair is styled back, revealing a high forehead. He is wearing an elaborate outfit with a lace collar and a richly patterned cloak. The man holds an ornate sword in his right hand, with an intricate hilt visible. The background includes architectural elements like columns, creating a grand setting. The scene is rendered in a black and white etching style.

artworks.title: Ernest of Austria, Archduke, Governor of the Spanish Netherlands
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest up, positioned slightly angled to the viewer's left but facing forward. His facial features include prominent eyebrows, an elongated mustache, and a neatly trimmed goatee. His hair is wavy and styled close to his head. He wears a richly decorated garment, featuring ornate patterns and a large, lace ruff around his neck. The background is a simple, dark, dotted pattern set within an ornate oval border. The border includes text that identifies the individual as ERNESTUS.

artworks.title: Prince Ernest, Duke of Saxony and Cleves
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a person with long, wavy hair, a prominent mustache, and a solemn yet direct gaze. The individual is dressed in an ornate garment with an elaborate lace collar, layered fabric, and intricate patterns. There is no jewelry or objects visible. The background features engraved lines forming a simple backdrop. An oval frame surrounds the portrait with inscribed text.

artworks.title: Ernest, Elector of Brandenburg
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man facing slightly to the right with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a neatly trimmed beard, mustache, and waves in his hair styled away from his forehead. The man has a calm expression, wearing ornate historical noble attire with a high, lace-trimmed collar and a patterned garment with visible buttons. The border around the portrait is decorated with text and intricate designs, including two coats of arms on the sides. The background is a textured surface.

artworks.title: Ernest, Margrave of Brandenburg
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a man from the chest up, facing forward with a slight turn to his right. He has curly dark hair, styled back, and a neatly trimmed mustache and small beard. He is dressed in a formal outfit and the background features a textured circular field with lines radiating from the man. Surrounding the circle is an inscription and beneath it is a text box with additional script.
